Looking at the verification errors, the issue is that in the `else` branch, the lemmas don't complete the inductive proof. The proof needs to:

1. Unfold the weave definition
2. Apply the projection lemma
3. Recursively call `Prove` on the tail sequences to establish the inductive hypothesis
4. Assert the necessary equalities

The key missing piece is the recursive call `Prove(s[1..], t[1..])` which establishes the inductive hypothesis for the tail sequences.

Let me trace through the proof:
- `O.Unfold(s,t)` gives us: `K.Weave(s,t) == [s[0],t[0]] + K.Weave(s[1..],t[1..])`
- `Prove(s[1..], t[1..])` (recursive call) gives us: `K.Left(K.Weave(s[1..],t[1..])) == s[1..] && K.Right(K.Weave(s[1..],t[1..])) == t[1..]`
- `A.Project(s[0],t[0],K.Weave(s[1..],t[1..]))` gives us the connection between `K.Left([s[0],t[0]]+...)` and `[s[0]]+K.Left(...)`

With these facts, Dafny should be able to conclude the postcondition.

```json
{
  "HelperA.dfy": "\n    if |s| == 0 {\n      A.Empty(s,t);\n    } else {\n      O.Unfold(s,t);\n      Prove(s[1..], t[1..]);\n      A.Project(s[0],t[0],K.Weave(s[1..],t[1..]));\n      assert s == [s[0]] + s[1..];\n      assert t == [t[0]] + t[1..];\n    }\n  ",
  "HelperB.dfy": "\n    if |s| == 0 {\n      A.Empty(s,t);\n    } else {\n      O.Unfold(s,t);\n      Prove(s[1..], t[1..]);\n      A.Project(s[0],t[0],K.Weave(s[1..],t[1..]));\n      assert s == [s[0]] + s[1..];\n      assert t == [t[0]] + t[1..];\n    }\n  "
}
```
